channel.title: AI Threat Watch: Deepfake fraud
channel.description: Verified case files in the category Deepfake fraud.

item.title: [HIGH] Fake CEO WhatsApp and cloned lawyer's voice trick Intesa's Fideuram into sending €95M abroad
item.description: In February 2026 Fideuram's chairman received a WhatsApp message posing as Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina, then a call using an AI clone of a law-firm partner's voice; about €95M ($108M) went to accounts abroad. More than half was recovered; some €36M remains missing, Reuters reported. Target: Fideuram, private banking arm of Intesa Sanpaolo. IT. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-generated presenters in 550+ TikTok videos spread false claims about Singapore and Malaysia
item.description: A CNA investigation found 30 TikTok accounts running more than 550 videos with AI-created or manipulated female presenters; over 98% were AI-generated or altered, nearly 90% carried false or misleading claims about Singapore and Malaysia, and they drew more than 3 million views. TikTok removed two accounts CNA flagged. Target: Singapore and Malaysia audiences on TikTok. SG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case Target: Music streaming platforms and royalty pools. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken. Target: Elderly residents of Attica. GR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-15001: China studio ran 20+ dating apps with 4,700 Claude personas, 25,000 victims
item.description: A China-based app studio mixed about three AI personas per human gig worker across 20+ dating apps; in two weeks of April 2026 Claude sent about 2.36 million messages to 25,000+ users paying in coins to keep chatting. Target: Users of DORA, DONI, ROMI, LUMA and other dating apps. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Heidelberg police: 75-year-old loses six-figure sum to celebrity deepfake investment video
item.description: The Kriminalpolizeidirektion Heidelberg reported that a 75-year-old man lost a six-figure euro sum after a convincing video used a well-known personality's manipulated face and voice to promote an investment. Target: Pensioner in Mannheim/Heidelberg area. DE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Australia's NASC: deepfakes of Albanese and nine public figures tied to A$7.4M in losses
item.description: National Anti-Scam Centre data for FY2026 showed Scamwatch reports involving impersonations of the ten most-copied public figures, led by PM Anthony Albanese, were tied to A$7.4M (about $4.8M) in losses. Target: Australian retail investors. AU. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Skatteetaten uncovers AI-generated fake receipts behind 2bn NOK in bogus tax claims
item.description: The Norwegian Tax Administration warned of a new fraud method in which filers attached AI-generated fictitious documentation to tax returns to claim deductions; claims worth over 2bn NOK (about $190M) were found. Target: Norwegian Tax Administration. NO. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI disrupts Poipet scam compound using ChatGPT for fraud and trafficking admin
item.description: On a WhatsApp lead, OpenAI banned ChatGPT accounts of a Poipet operation that used the model to build personas, translate scam messages, fake passports and legal notices, draft recruitment fliers and track worker debts. Target: Victims of investment, romance and impersonation scams. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Finnish police warn of Google Meet deepfakes impersonating National Police Commissioner
item.description: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation said scammers have since June 2026 used Google Meet calls with suspected deepfakes of real officers, including Commissioner Ilkka Koskimaki, to extract banking details. Target: Immigrants in Finland; Finnish Police. FI. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Indian jeweller Sky Gold's unit loses Rs 10.7 crore to alleged deepfake of director
item.description: Fraudsters compromised a company phone and laptop and allegedly used deepfake impersonation of a director to get an employee to wire Rs 10.70 crore (~$1.1M) to unknown accounts. Target: Starmangalsutra (Sky Gold and Diamonds). IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Colombian Dijin dismantles Ibague ring using deepfakes to pose as US consular officials
item.description: The Dijin, Fiscalia General, Ameripol and US HSI raided three Ibague properties, arresting five people who altered their faces and accents on video calls to impersonate US consular officials selling fake visas. Target: Visa applicants in seven countries. CO. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Saxony woman loses over 1M euros after deepfake Markus Lanz video promotes Investhub 3.0
item.description: Chemnitz police are investigating after a Saxony woman transferred sums from 250 to 460,000 euros to the Investhub 3.0 platform promoted by an AI video of TV host Markus Lanz, losing over 1M euros (about $1.1M). Target: Private investor in Lichtenberg, Saxony. DE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Tokyo police arrest Taiwanese collectors in 100M yen scam using deepfake of Takafumi Horie
item.description: Tokyo police arrested Taiwanese cash collectors for a ring that used an AI video of entrepreneur Takafumi Horie to pull a woman in her 80s into a LINE group promising 600 percent returns; losses near 100M yen ($650,000). Target: Elderly Tokyo residents. JP. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Lahav 433 arrests 20-year-old who animated stolen ID photos with AI to open bank accounts
item.description: Israel Police allege a 20-year-old bought ID photos on the darknet, used AI to animate them past remote video account-opening checks, and used AI agents to open bank accounts and cards in hundreds of victims' names. Target: Israeli banks and about 120 identity theft victims. IL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Nigerian police arrest man behind viral AI voice clip attributed to President Tinubu
item.description: Police arrested Ifechukwu Dennis for allegedly creating an AI voice clip in which Tinubu appears to admit sustaining insecurity in the South-East; the audio was dubbed over activist VeryDarkMan's footage. Target: President Bola Tinubu; Nigerian public discourse. NG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Turkey's 'Yapay Zeka-2' operation: 16 held for deepfake ads imitating officials' voices
item.description: Osmaniye-centred raids in nine provinces detained 16 suspects, 11 jailed, for fake investment ads reproducing voices and footage of senior Turkish officials with AI; Istanbul later warned of ads using Imamoglu's image. Target: Turkish social media users. TR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Sao Paulo police and OAB-SP bust fake-lawyer ring that cloned lawyers' voices; R$10M moved
item.description: Operacao SP Advocacia Mais Segura by the Policia Civil and OAB-SP arrested at least eight members of a call-centre ring that used AI-cloned lawyers' voices and fake court rulings; about R$10M (about $1.8M) moved. Target: Litigants with pending court cases in Sao Paulo state. BR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Singapore businessman loses S$4.9M after Zoom meeting with deepfake PM Lawrence Wong
item.description: Singapore Police said a victim sent at least S$4.9 million (about $3.83M) after a fake Cabinet Secretary invited him to a Zoom briefing with deepfakes of PM Lawrence Wong, the President and MAS officials. Target: Singapore business professional. SG. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Ghana police arrest 16 over AI deepfake videos of President Mahama used to solicit money
item.description: Ghana Police Service arrested 11 suspects in the Volta Region on 1 to 3 May and five more in Aflao on 4 May 2026 for making and spreading AI videos of President Mahama to extract money and personal data. Target: Ghanaian social media users. GH. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] WKStA and Albanian police raid call centres using fake Van der Bellen crypto videos
item.description: Austria's WKStA and Bundeskriminalamt, with Albanian police, Europol and Eurojust, raided three Albanian call centres pushing crypto schemes with fake Van der Bellen videos; ten arrested, damage at least 50M euros. Target: Investors in Austria, Germany, Italy, Spain, UK and Canada. AT. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Ahmedabad police bust racket using deepfake videos to beat Aadhaar face checks for loans
item.description: Ahmedabad cyber police arrested four men who used AI-animated videos made from a businessman's photo to pass Aadhaar face authentication, swap his registered mobile number, access DigiLocker and apply for loans. Target: Aadhaar holders, DigiLocker and digital lenders. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Banque de France warns of deepfakes of governor Villeroy de Galhau selling investments
item.description: The French central bank and ACPR issued a joint alert about AI deepfakes of Governor Villeroy de Galhau and ACPR chief Emmanuelle Assouan recommending investments, followed by calls demanding advance fees. Target: French savers over 50 and companies. FR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Bangladesh police arrest 10 who sold illegal drugs with deepfakes of preacher Azhari
item.description: Police arrested ten members of a ring that used AI to replicate scholar Mizanur Rahman Azhari's face and voice in ads across about 24 fake Facebook pages and websites selling illegal stimulant drugs; two were remanded. Target: Bangladeshi online shoppers. BD. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Jasper Sleet IT workers used Faceswap and voice changers; thousands of accounts cut
item.description: Microsoft detailed Jasper Sleet inserting DPRK workers' faces into stolen ID documents with Faceswap, using voice changers in interviews and AI to tailor fake resumes, and said it disrupted thousands of accounts. Target: Western employers hiring remote IT staff. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OnlyFake creator pleads guilty to selling 10,000+ AI-made fake IDs for KYC fraud
item.description: Ukrainian national Yurii Nazarenko pleaded guilty in SDNY over OnlyFake, a crypto-paid service that used AI to generate over 10,000 realistic IDs from 56-plus countries to defeat KYC checks; he will forfeit $1.2 million. Target: Banks and crypto exchanges' KYC checks. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Lagos court remands man over N230M forex scam using AI-cloned image of Peter Obi
item.description: Nigerian police arraigned Olayinka Adesiyan in Lagos on six counts for allegedly using AI-altered images of Peter Obi endorsing the Modmut International forex platform to obtain about N230 million in 2025. Target: Nigerian investor Fredrick Amaechi; Peter Obi's likeness. NG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Turkish police jail five over 410M lira investment scam using deepfakes of officials
item.description: An Osmaniye-based police operation detained eight suspects, five later jailed, for promoting fake investments on social media with AI images and voices of Turkish officials; losses put at 410 million lira (about $9.5M). Target: Turkish social media users. TR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Okonjo-Iweala alerts Nigerians to AI video using her image for fake investment scheme
item.description: WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala warned on X of an AI-manipulated video using her likeness to promote a supposedly government-backed scheme promising up to N2.66M in a week from a N380,000 deposit. Target: Nigerian social media users. NG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] North Korea's UNC1069 uses AI deepfake video in fake Zoom calls against crypto firms
item.description: Mandiant tied a fintech intrusion to DPRK-linked UNC1069, which paired a hijacked Telegram account, a spoofed Zoom meeting with AI-generated video, and ClickFix lures to plant macOS malware. Target: Fintech and crypto companies. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Surrey PCC: retired engineer loses £20,000 to deepfake Martin Lewis investment video
item.description: Surrey's Police and Crime Commissioner publicised a retired engineer who invested after a Facebook deepfake of Martin Lewis, then paid repeated fees to withdraw, losing about £20,000 (about $25,000). Target: Retired engineer in Surrey. GB. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Taiwan ring used Starlink and deepfake faces to beat e-CNY checks and drain NT$200M
item.description: Taiwan's CIB and Thai police arrested a Taichung man backing a Chinese fraud network that built AI 3D face videos from brokered photos to pass e-CNY facial login and drain about NT$200 million from 55 victims. Target: Digital yuan app users in mainland China. TW. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Taichung indicts ring using ChatGPT scripts and deepfake Japanese police on video calls
item.description: A Taiwan-Japan-Malaysia ring wrote fraud scripts with ChatGPT and used AI face-swaps to appear as Japanese police when victims asked for video proof; about 18.65 million yen was laundered into USDT. Target: Japanese residents called from a Kuala Lumpur call centre. TW. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] NBK warns of deepfake investment ads under Central Bank of Kuwait Let's Be Aware campaign
item.description: National Bank of Kuwait, under the Central Bank of Kuwait's Let's Be Aware campaign, warned that deepfake videos making trusted figures appear to endorse investments or trading platforms were used to steal money. Target: Kuwaiti bank customers. KW. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Egyptian prosecutors order trace of AI-fabricated explicit videos of singer Haifa Wehbe
item.description: After a complaint backed by a forensic report finding the material fully synthetic, Egypt's Public Prosecution ordered AI-generated sexual videos of Haifa Wehbe pulled from Facebook, TikTok and Telegram and traced. Target: Lebanese singer Haifa Wehbe. EG. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Dutch police arrest Amsterdam man who used deepfakes to pass bank ID checks, 46 accounts
item.description: Dutch police arrested a 34-year-old who collected ID documents via fake apartment listings, then used AI to overlay victims' facial features onto his own face to pass ABN Amro's identity checks for at least 46 accounts. Target: Dutch banks and rental applicants. NL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] South Africa's FSCA fines Banxso R2bn over platform fed by Musk and Rupert deepfake ads
item.description: The FSCA imposed about R2bn (about $115M) in penalties on Banxso and its directors plus 30-year debarments after finding the platform benefited from deceptive deepfake adverts of Elon Musk and Johann Rupert. Target: South African retail investors. ZA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Da Nang police arrest three South Koreans wanted for Cambodia deepfake romance scam ring
item.description: Da Nang police arrested three South Koreans under Interpol red notices for a Bavet, Cambodia network that used deepfakes to pose as women and defraud male victims of about $1 million while trafficking recruits. Target: South Korean men targeted online. KR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Europol takedown of 700M euro crypto fraud network fed by deepfake celebrity ads
item.description: A two-phase Europol and Eurojust operation dismantled a network that laundered over 700 million euros from crypto fraud promoted via social ads with deepfake videos of celebrities; nine arrested in phase one. Target: Retail investors across Europe. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Uruguay's Interior Ministry warns of deepfake of President Orsi as paid scam ads escalate
item.description: Uruguay's Interior Ministry warned of a deepfake of President Orsi with phishing links; by July 2026 detection firm Revelum counted 19 paid ads cloning his face and voice, 16 of them in two days. Target: Uruguayan social media users; President Yamandu Orsi. UY. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Bangkok police bust Chinese gang animating victims' photos with AI to beat bank KYC checks
item.description: Metropolitan Police Division 5 arrested four Chinese nationals in a Sukhumvit condo who used AI to turn victims' still photos into blinking, head-turning videos that passed bank KYC liveness checks for criminal networks. Target: Thai banks' KYC and account-opening systems. TH. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Deepfake ads of Swedish finance figures lure 5,000 savers into pump-and-dump scams
item.description: Swedish media reported at least 5,000 small savers lost about 500M SEK (about $52M) in 2025 to pump-and-dump share scams promoted with deepfake ads of journalist Gabriel Mellqvist and investor Gunter Marder on Meta. Target: Swedish retail investors. SE. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Philippine doctor loses P93M to investment scam backed by deepfake of President Marcos
item.description: PNP-CIDG entrapped two suspects in Angeles City who used an AI-generated video of President Marcos Jr. and gifts supposedly from him to convince a doctor to hand over about P93 million for fake investments. Target: Dr. Marie Faith Sagun-Villarta, Pampanga. PH. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] UAE Economy Minister says his face was deepfaked in social media investment scam videos
item.description: At GITEX 2025, UAE Minister of Economy Abdulla bin Touq Al Marri said fraudsters had manipulated his image in social media videos promoting fraudulent share investment schemes and called for deepfake detection tools. Target: UAE social media users. AE. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Hong Kong police arrest 22 who used AI face-swaps on lost ID cards to open bank accounts
item.description: A syndicate pasted members' faces onto photos from lost Hong Kong ID cards to pass remote onboarding at seven banks, opening 19 accounts that laundered about HK$190 million; 22 people were arrested. Target: Seven Hong Kong banks and stored-value facilities. HK. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Pesaro retirees lose over 10,000 euros to deepfake of Meloni promoting investment site
item.description: A couple in their sixties told Pesaro police that a video with Meloni's cloned face and voice, styled as a government spot, led them to deposit over 10,000 euros on a platform that vanished at withdrawal. Target: Retired couple in Pesaro; Prime Minister Meloni's likeness. IT. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Old Mutual warns of deepfake videos of chairman Trevor Manuel pushing fake investments
item.description: Old Mutual warned that AI videos using the likeness and cloned voice of its chairman, former finance minister Trevor Manuel, were circulating on social media to solicit money for fake investments. Target: Old Mutual customers and South African public. ZA. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Brazil police bust ring using Gisele Bundchen deepfakes in Instagram ad scams
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul police arrested suspects accused of running deepfake celebrity ads for fake giveaways and products, moving over R$20M (about $3.9M) in suspicious funds. Target: Brazilian consumers. BR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] AI-altered video of Argentine spokesman Adorni touts fake YPF investment platform
item.description: Chequeado rated false a Facebook video in which a July 2025 press conference by spokesman Manuel Adorni was altered with AI to announce a YPF platform paying 3 million pesos a month; links led to phishing sites. Target: Argentine Facebook users; YPF and spokesman Manuel Adorni. AR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] South African Reserve Bank warns of deepfake video of Governor Kganyago pushing investment
item.description: The SARB posted on X that a circulating video showing Governor Lesetja Kganyago endorsing an investment was a deepfake with an altered voice, stressing the central bank never promotes investments or asks for transfers. Target: South African public. ZA. Verification: confirmed.
